items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: The transcript contains no turns by the interviewee (Zutty Singleton). The mention of Alma is entirely within the interviewer's narrative ('I called his daughter and told Alma about it...'). Zutty himself does not speak or describe a relationship.

ctx.x: Well you know, it stops you in certain ways, but then on the other hand, you know, some people that have a lot of education they have been stumped in other ways. They don't know life, you know, I was talking to......

Always says, Alma always says if you have a degree you can sit down. She has one degree and now she's studying, she says she's going back in January, she has to make a few more points to get her Masters.
